name: heos
description: Root orchestration only — app/ and server/ each keep their own independent node_modules and package-lock.json (Railway deploys each from its own subdirectory). This package.json exists to fan out shared commands and host the pre-commit hook, not to host app/server's own dependencies.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix app && npm run typecheck --prefix server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix app && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix app && npm run lint:fix --prefix server
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix app && npm run format --prefix server
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --prefix app && npm run format:check --prefix server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
